system.en: If you lose access to the land where you keep your cows and grow your vegetables, you lose the system that allows you to feed yourself.
system.zh: 如果你失去了饲养奶牛和种植蔬菜的土地的使用权，你就失去了让你能够养活自己的系统。

system.en: This is why fission plants need so many layers of safety systems, and those layers are a big part of what makes them so expensive to build.
system.zh: 这就是为什么裂变电站需要层层安全系统，而这些安全系统正是造价如此高昂的主要原因。
